# CoachTube

> > CoachTube is an online platform providing instructional coaching videos and courses across multiple sports, taught by expert coaches and athletes.

CoachTube offers comprehensive training content spanning football, baseball, softball, basketball, tennis, swimming, lacrosse, golf, and health & fitness. Courses feature renowned coaches and athletes including Chris Husby, Dennis Hill, Gilad Bloom, and organizations like the National Fastpitch Coaches Association (NFCA), covering everything from fundamental skills and drills to advanced performance training and sports psychology.

## Platform Overview

- [CoachTube Home](https://coachtube.com): Main platform offering instructional coaching videos and online courses across all sports

## Football Coaching

- [Football Skill and Drills](https://coachtube.com/course/football/football-skill-and-drills/30065): Chris Husby's comprehensive football fundamentals course covering essential skills and drills
- [The Basics of Defense](https://coachtube.com/course/football/the-basics-of-defense/92162): Dennis Hill's defensive fundamentals course with drills and techniques
- [Basic Run Blocking Techniques: Part I](https://coachtube.com/course/football/basic-run-blocking-techniques-part-i/812669): Jim McNally's offensive line run blocking fundamentals Part I
- [Panther Offense vs Bronco Defense in the Super Bowl](https://coachtube.com/course/football/panther-offense-vs-bronco-defense-in-the-super-bowl/542063): Alex Kirby's Super Bowl analysis: Panthers offense vs Broncos defense

## Baseball & Softball Coaching

- [Mental Side Approach to Hitting](https://coachtube.com/course/baseball/mental-side-approach-to-hitting/604407): Steve Springer's sports psychology course focused on hitting mindset and mental approach
- [Building a Successful Softball Business](https://coachtube.com/course/softball/building-a-successful-softball-business-nfca2013/514695): Sara Hayes NFCA course on softball business development and entrepreneurship

## Individual Sports Coaching

- [Master Your Forehand & Backhand in Tennis](https://coachtube.com/course/tennis/master-your-forehand-backhand-in-tennis/185767): Gilad Bloom's tennis stroke technique course for forehand and backhand mastery
- [One Minute Video Series (Golf)](https://coachtube.com/course/golf/one-minute-video-series/99292): Ben Austin's 8-week golf instruction series with concise one-minute videos
- [Swimming Coaching Videos](https://coachtube.com/courses/swimming): Swimming courses catalog with coaching videos and training content
- [Learn to Swim in 8 Lessons or Less](https://coachtube.com/course/swimming/learn-to-swim-in-8-lessons-or-less/105899): BobbyBroome's beginner swimming instruction course in 8 lessons

## Team Sports Coaching

- [Girls Lacrosse Drills & Tips Video Library](https://coachtube.com/course/lacrosse/girls-lacrosse-drills-tips-video-library/89050): Sheehan Stanwick Bur's comprehensive library with 80+ girls lacrosse drills and tips

## Health, Fitness & Performance

- [Nutrition 101 for Athletes](https://coachtube.com/course/health-fitness/nutrition-101-for-athletes/60522): St. Vincent Sports Performance dietitian course on athlete nutrition fundamentals
- [A1 Sports Performance & Rehab](https://coachtube.com/course/health-fitness/a1-sports-performance-rehab/68000): Sprinting basics and essential drills for athletic performance and rehabilitation
- [Triphasic Training](https://coachtube.com/course/health-fitness/triphasic-training-a-systematic-approach-to-elite-speed-and-explosive-strength-performance/567957): Systematic approach to elite speed and explosive strength performance training
